article_notes: 50 dogs with tick-borne infections diagnosed by smear (41 B. gibsoni, 9 E. canis). Table 1 compares haematology between B. gibsoni and E. canis infected dogs (different pathogens, not severity). Recurrence with later kidney failure in 10 B. gibsoni dogs is reported, but no marker or factor is compared against it. No healthy controls. Nothing extractable against severity.
